Name: Yandere Emily
Author: bhallspawns
Description:
[b]Please be careful when using other mods in addition to this mod that may slightly alter or add, or completely change, Emily's dialogues and events.
[/b]It was a bit complicated to make Emily into Yandere, as her personality changes a lot when you add in the element of "Yandere" to her, but this is how I see a Yandere Emily. I hope you enjoy if you download.

What's included in this mod: 0-2-4-6-8-10 Heart dialogues, 1-year festivals dialogues, 1.6 added dialogues, bouquet & pendant + breakup & divorce dialogues, resort dialogues, marrying Haley or Shane dialogues changed. As of right now, there is no marriage, new 1.6 festivals, or event changes.

Thank you for your support.

(If wondering what the interface and portrait is in the header image, here are the links. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]INTERFACE [/url]/ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25275]PORTRAIT[/url].)
